title: Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate
function: Mixed metal oxide coated substrate mesh/plate
alloyReason: Grade 2 Commercially Pure Titanium provides excellent corrosion resistance in chemical environments, good formability and weldability, and moderate strength. It is the standard material for chemical processing equipment, heat exchangers, and marine components where corrosion resistance is the primary requirement.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)
Thread damage from improper installation torque exceeding recommended values
Galvanic corrosion at interface with dissimilar metals in electrolyte environments

faq.q: What is a titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: A titanium mmo-coated substrate plate is a precision-machined electrochemical component used in mixed metal oxide coated substrate mesh/plate. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate is designed for mixed metal oxide coated substrate mesh/plate. The Grade 2 CP-Ti grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium mmo-coated substrate plate manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate is manufactured using Powder sintering. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
